issues.description: The template's StockIngredient class exposes the ingredient quantity using retrieveQuantity(), but other code (Stock.java) and the solution expect getQuantity(). The problem statement also asks students to add getters for all private fields, implying the standard getX naming. This identifier mismatch will cause compilation errors in the template (Stock.java calls getQuantity()) and confuses students about which getter name to implement.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the quantity getter in the template StockIngredient from retrieveQuantity() to getQuantity(), or update Stock.java calls to use retrieveQuantity(). Prefer changing the StockIngredient method to getQuantity() to match the problem statement's getter convention and the solution implementation.
